title: Official gRPC and Protobuf Interoperability Case Registry
description: Versioned case registry pinning official test suites, procedure sources, peer directions, transports, profiles, owners, and present coverage across pure-protobuf and pbrs-grpc.

disposition_definitions.passed: Verified passing in official test scripts, peer passes, or conformance harness.
disposition_definitions.not_run: Active upstream test case or procedure scheduled for execution, not yet run in official harness.
disposition_definitions.unsupported: Protocol feature, RPC pattern, or service not yet implemented in target profile.
disposition_definitions.blocked_external: Blocked by external dependencies (e.g. cloud provider credentials, GCP metadata service, network authority). Never marked not_applicable.
disposition_definitions.not_applicable: Explicitly excluded with approved, documented technical justification (e.g. C/upb internal arena layouts).

cases.name: Cacheable Unary Call
cases.justification: Unratified experimental procedure not included in gRPC over HTTP/2 specification (doc/PROTOCOL-HTTP2.md mandates :method POST). Omitted from active upstream test runner (run_interop_tests.py), rejected in C++ core (HttpServerFilter), broken in grpc-java, and unimplemented in grpc-go. Excluded with maintainer approval due to CSRF and query-string credential disclosure hazards (see docs/cacheable-rpc.md).

present_coverage.notes: Resolved as not_applicable in EX-20. The baseline native gRPC kernel strictly enforces POST. See docs/cacheable-rpc.md.

Qualified both cross-peer directions against the pinned C++ peer (grpc/grpc@d1487957, v1.84.0) via scripts/grpc-interop-cpp.sh: the C++ server enforces the request compression bit (INVALID_ARGUMENT when absent). After the three official calls, the native client adds a separate high-entropy compressed request; this is additional coverage, not a replacement for the specified zero-filled vector. Self-interop also passes; grpc-go cross-peer stays skipped (no expect_compressed/response_compressed flags).
